title: HiLand Optimization
description: [1.20.1  Fabric/Forge] Optimized Minecraft experience without extra graphics.
body:
![Banner HiLand Optimize](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b0f8b45c49c1763bae0dea8779ede4aefd5a2c5c.png) The modpack is designed to supercharge FPS, boost smoothness, and speed up Minecraft like never before! It keeps the game streamlined, and free of unnecessary visual clutter, making it perfect for pure vanilla gameplay or for seamless integration into other modpacks. Optimized for most PCs, it delivers a fast, fluid, and truly enjoyable experience for every player.

✅ Now available on Forge 1.20.1!

## Personalization

The pack already includes a configured config file suitable for many users. Settings are balanced between visual quality and performance but can be adjusted if desired.
